title.narrative: Capacity Building of Arab Water Council

description.narrative: The task is to build up the capacity of the Arab Water Council through the following activities: (i) Conference bringing together key policymakers and other stakeholders in the region to discuss water governance reforms; (ii) Consultancies to bring key experts of international repute to provoke discussions among MENA's senior water professionals about furthering Integrated Water Resource Management; (iii) Promotion of public disclosure of information relevant to integrated water resource management through the AWC website; and (iv) Support for the creation of Arab Water Management Institute through curriculum development and institutional scoping/needs and possibilities assessment. This task is to be linked with the IDF Trust Fund (TF058148). Grant closing date is 3/11/2010. The strategic objective is to promote Integrated Water Resource management in the Middle East and North Africa region by strengthening the capacity of the newly-formed Arab Water Council. This body will promote inter-governmental coordination, outreach to civil society, will help build trust and generate new knowledge about water management. 03/22/07. IDF Grant declared effective on 3/11/07. Task Team Leader changed from Storu Ueda (UPI#18134) to Julia Bucknall (UPI#83673) effective July 1, 2008. 06/08/09: Change of TTL from Julia Bucknall(UPI#83673) to Claire Kfouri (UPI#304817). Ref Claire Kfouri Email dated 06/08/2009 Re: Fw: IDF grants for inst strengthening of Arab Water Council. Effective 07/01/2009 3/18/10. IDF (TF058148) totalling $300K closed 3/11/10 and end-disbursement date 7/11/10. The undisbursed balance amount to $33,240. The development objective is to generate changes in national institutions and policies in Arab countries of the Middle East and North Africa to enable more efficient water management in the region. The newly formed Arab Water Council (AWC) has the potential and vision to become a key vehicle to drive these changes by fulfilling a role of promoting transparency, accountability and technology for integrated water management in the region.
